title: Toes in the Water Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Bright and cheery, the ‘Windward’ cottage celebrates a fantastic location and comfortable accommodations.
description_expanded: 130 Pensacola StreetCompletely Renovated Seaside Cottage with Modern Coastal StyleToes In The Water is a bright and cheery Seaside vacation cottage featuring a completely renovated kitchen, all bathrooms, and brand-new furnishings throughout. Perfectly positioned for a relaxing beach escape, this exceptional three-bedroom, three-bath home offers ultra-comfortable accommodations and a fantastic location just steps from Seaside’s best amenities.Inviting Front Porch & First-Floor King BedroomsA welcoming open front porch with lounge seating for two sets the tone for laid-back coastal living. Inside, the first floor features two beautifully updated king bedrooms. The newly furnished king primary bedroom includes a dresser for storage and a wall-mounted flat-screen TV, with a sliding barn door leading to the recently remodeled ensuite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and single vanity. The second king guest bedroom offers an oversized dresser and a large wall-mounted flat-screen TV, along with direct access to a newly updated full bathroom with a modern tub/shower combination. A full-size washer and dryer are conveniently located in the laundry closet at the base of the first-floor staircase.Open-Concept Living & Fully Renovated KitchenThe second level is designed for gathering, with an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The newly furnished living room features a wall-mounted flat-screen TV, custom built-ins, and large windows that fill the space with natural light. The fully renovated kitchen is well-equipped with modern stainless steel appliances, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, farmhouse sink, and a new island with bar-top seating for six guests. Just off the living area, a screened-in balcony offers outdoor dining for six—perfect for enjoying coastal breezes and relaxed meals.Loft-Style Bunk Room & Tower with Gulf ViewsOn the third floor, an open loft-style bunk area features a twin-over-queen bunk bed, surrounded by windows and equipped with a television. This space opens onto a charming open-air tower with bar seating for two, showcasing panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico, unforgettable sunsets, and scenic Seaside rooftops.Outdoor Living & Prime West Side LocationFor evenings spent at home, the cottage includes a pole-mounted grill ideal for family meals, along with an outdoor shower for easy post-beach cleanup. Located just steps from the West Side swimming pool, Toes In The Water also provides convenient access to Seaside’s many amenities, including multiple swimming pools, tennis and pickleball courts, and a fitness center—making this cottage an ideal choice for a memorable Seaside, Florida vacation.* Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance with a Ring doorbell. * 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,406 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceAccess to the Seaside Private Residential Beach at Pensacola Pavilion3-minute walk (176 yards) to beach access, offering one of the largest stretches of private residential beaches along Scenic Highway 30ASteps from the West Side swimming poolPeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 community swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), along with a fitness centerWelcome tote including two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking policy: Two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered vehiclesGolf cart policy: Golf carts are not permitted for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002356
